title: Everybody Loves: Frogs
description: Because everybody loves, and everybody loves frogs!
body:
![A series of Minecraft frogs looking at the viewer with their toungues out, their toungues are painted in various patterns representing Pride flags.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fedfc4146da47b46c69a7cb30b7a696e0e4f14f7.png)

# Everybody Loves: Frogs
In keeping with tradition we wanted to help more Minecraft mobs celebrate Pride this year.  
What do people love as much as [Bees](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/everybody-lovesbees) and their [Bee Hives](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/everybody-loves-hives)?  

Well, frogs and their... tongues?  
You can now catch a glimpse of your frog's pride flag of choice whenever they're on the hunt for some food.  

Because everybody loves, and everybody loves frogs... and tongue 😛

## Everybody Loves  
Want more celebratory mobs in your world? Check out [Everybody Loves: Bees](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/everybody-lovesbees), and keep your eye on the [Everybody Loves collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/zi1cybwo)!

## How it works
Thanks to the power of [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features), we're able to add on to the Frog's model in a way that won't affect normal gameplay, vanilla users, or other resource packs, and will even work with frog variants added by other mods and data packs!   

This pack is easy to modify, add on to, or integrate with other resource packs.  
You're more than welcome to make an addon or integrate this with your own resource pack, just be sure to provide credit in your project's Description.

<center>

![An image showing frogs from other Minecraft projects being affected by the resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3aefd5d04dddedc3874cf68b926e823275b98de5.png)
*Prideful frogs from [Coming soon](https://modrinth.com/project/k5iSA2Hc), [Whimscape](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/whimscape), and [More Frogs 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/morefrogs)*

</center>



You don't even need to fluoridate your water supply to add a flag to a frog!  
Simply rename it with a name including one of these phrases:

<details>
<summary>Names</summary>

- ace
- agender
- aro
- bisexual
- demi
- gay
- genderfluid
- genderqueer
- intersex
- lesbian
- nonbinary
- pan
- poly
- pride
- progress
- trans

</details>



## Support your community
Minecraft is **everybody's game**, and this community has been a meaningful and accepting place for us and many others. If you love our content or any of the other amazing creations this scene has produced, then know that it would not be here if it were not for those who work hard to make it an accepting and loving place.  

If you're reading this while it's still the month of June and are looking for a way to help make a difference, we encourage you to join us and the broader Minecraft community by supporting queer individuals in need. Optionally, through the Modrinth fundraiser at https://modrinth.com/pride.
